overview.description: ELISA (enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay) quantifies an antigen in solution using antibodies and a colourimetric readout. With a standard curve, it turns a colour change into a concentration.

steps.description: ELISA (enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay) quantifies an antigen in solution using antibodies and a colourimetric readout. With a standard curve, it turns a colour change into a concentration.
steps.intro: ELISA (enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay) quantifies an antigen in solution using antibodies and a colourimetric readout. With a standard curve, it turns a colour change into a concentration.

instructions.title: Pick a format
instructions.description: Choose direct, indirect or sandwich ELISA based on your antibodies and sensitivity needs.

instructions.title: Coat & block
instructions.description: Immobilise antigen or capture antibody, then block the plate.

instructions.title: Detect & quantify
instructions.description: Add detection antibody and substrate, read absorbance, and interpolate against a standard curve.

submission.description: Run (or design) an ELISA with a standard curve and report the calculated concentration of your sample.

kits.name: ELISA Immuno Explorer kit
kits.note: Run a plate-based antigen/antibody assay with a colour readout and standard curve.

kits.name: ELISA classroom kit
kits.note: Simulated/real ELISA to teach sandwich detection and quantitation.
